note: Every downloaded file a school fact comes from. The files themselves live in data/sources/ and are gitignored: this repo is public, and AAMC licenses FACTS tables for noncommercial use only. To rebuild, download each url to its file path; scripts/db/seed-residency.mjs refuses a file whose sha256 does not match. Each entry becomes a row in public.data_sources, and the licence notice stored there is read from the file itself.
